/opt/libretv-trial/compose.yaml.source:
name: libretv-trial
services:
  web:
    image: ghcr.io/librespark/libretv:2.21.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:18080:8080"
    env_file: .env
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      COOKIE_SECURE: "true"
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: "1"
    mem_limit: 768m
    cpus: 1.0
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"

package.name: libretv
package.description: 免费在线视频搜索与观看平台（Next.js 重构版）
